doc: Worker-level corpus (gate p2-hostile-worker). Each case maps to exactly one invariant id (SPEC_INVARIANTS H). The oracle is the mock supervisor over F14; every case runs on both paths (zygote = fork+Wasm, cordon). expect: ok | fail | refused | refused-or-fail | ok-or-fail. traps: the F14 trap codes accepted in resp-end; death_ok: the worker may instead die/close without resp-end (a wall bound by ITIMER_REAL kills a fork child). limits: overrides of the F8 defaults sent in the request frame.

cases.doc: Vacuity: a well-behaved module answers through resp_head/resp_write.
Vacuity: data_run, result_read of a valid handle returns the supervisor's F10 result bytes, handle_drop.
The test-only env.host_fault in a golden build (D15): refused at compile.
WASI (no ambient I/O, D13): refused.
A non-allowlisted name in module aegis (egress fetch is out of scope, D13): refused.
An effective-context-switch import (survival table I1: no effective-context switch): refused.
An allowlisted name with another signature: refused.
A memory import: refused.
A global import: refused.
A table import: refused.
Missing handle export: refused at compile (F14 exports are exact).
An extra export: refused.
handle with a parameter: refused.
No memory export: refused.
A slot that was never issued (own handle + 1): trap 5.
Handle 0 (generation 0 is never issued): trap 5.
Own slot under another generation: trap 5.
Use after drop: trap 5.
Dropping twice: trap 5.
A handle issued to request n (emitted by a first request on the same connection/worker) presented in request n+1: trap 5. Handles die with the request.

A data_run whose tenant field names another tenant: the worker forwards the op bytes verbatim (it holds no authority and resolves nothing); the supervisor overwrites the tenant (host level h-i1-ctx-*).
A host-call pointer range outside memory 0: trap 7, nothing copied.
ABI misuse (log level 9) traps; no error code a module could probe with.
Infinite loop: ends by fuel or the wall bound well within wall_ms + grace.
A finite 3M-iteration loop under a 20,000-unit fuel limit: trap 1 (fuel is enforced, not advisory).
memory.grow one page at a time to 64 MiB: growth past memory_mib (16 MiB = 256 pages) is refused.
A declared initial memory of 20 MiB (> memory_mib): never instantiated.
table.grow by 1,048,576 elements is refused by the limiter (the module traps on -1).
Unbounded recursion: stack overflow trap (or fuel), the worker survives.
200,000 req_head calls against max_host_calls = 10,000: trap 6.
100 data_runs against max_data_runs = 64: trap 6 and at most 64 data-run frames reach the supervisor.
Each data_run reply is ~30 KB; max_data_bytes = 100,000: trap 6 by the 4th reply, no further data-run frames.
819,200 body bytes against max_resp_bytes = 65,536: trap 6; at most 65,536 body bytes are forwarded.
102,400 log bytes against max_log_bytes = 4,096: trap 6; at most 4,096 log bytes are forwarded.
